title: Patient Care Desk Guidance: Refunding Fees on Delivery & Pickup Services Orders Cancelled Before Dispatch
content:
Where the plan refunds fees of orders cancelled before dispatch, each fee charged on a Delivery & Pickup Services order that was cancelled before dispatch is refunded by its own cancellation refund, recorded as a refund entry naming that fee on the plan's charge ledger.

## Which fees, and how

The order's speed fee, its same-day fee or its express fee, is refunded as its cancellation refund amount; a distance or redelivery fee on such an order is refunded in full and falls outside this computation.

| Fee charged on the order cancelled before dispatch | Refund |
|---|---|
| same-day fee | its cancellation refund amount |
| express fee | its cancellation refund amount |
| distance fee | refunded in full |
| redelivery fee | refunded in full |

Each fee has its own refund entry; an order carrying both a speed fee and a distance fee therefore has two refund entries once both are refunded. Whether the plan refunds fees of orders cancelled before dispatch is the plan's own term in the Delivery & Pickup Services quick reference.

## Refunding a fee: `refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af`

**What it does.** Refunds one fee that was charged on a delivery order cancelled before it was dispatched. One call records a single refund, dated today, against the named fee and order with the stated amount and the reason cancelled before dispatch, and takes the amount off the fees the patient has paid on the plan; it does not decide whether a refund is owed or how much. Afterwards the refund appears in the plan's fee history next to the fee it returns.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af` and then calls it, once for each fee refunded.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `delivery_plan_id` | reference number of the delivery plan the cancelled order belongs to, as the delivery plan lookup shows it | id |
| `source_charge_id` | reference number of the single fee being refunded, as the delivery fee lookup shows it for the cancelled order | id |
| `source_order_id` | reference number of the cancelled delivery order the fee was charged on, as the delivery order lookup shows it | id |
| `amount_usd` | the amount refunded | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt listing `refund_reference` (the reference number of the booked refund), `delivery_plan_id`, `source_charge_id` (the fee refunded), `source_order_id` (the cancelled order), `refund_reason` (always "cancelled_before_dispatch"), `amount_usd` and `fees_net_usd` (the plan's fees paid net of refunds after this refund). A receipt carrying a refund reference means the refund was booked.

## Hypothetical illustration

A cancelled Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery order carried a same-day fee and a distance fee. The distance fee is refunded in full by one call naming that fee; the same-day fee is refunded at its cancellation refund amount by a second call naming the same-day fee. Each call returns its own refund reference.
